data.name: Alqamah
data.gender_notes: Alqamah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who possesses a deep understanding and knowledge of the world and its complexities, one who is considered a sage or a scholar. The name Alqamah carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Alqamah usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, the desire to understand the universe and the divine.
data.etymology: Alqamah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent, Knowledgeable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alqamah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

This name holds a high position in Islamic culture, where knowledge is highly valued and revered. Alqamah can be a reminder of the significance of lifelong learning, introspection, and understanding of our world and the universe at large.
